method: Inspected all frames in EN/RU contact sheets, plus original-resolution roadside, atlas and finance settings; checked ART_DIRECTION layout, typography, icons, endings and image continuity
scope: Readable controls, no clipping, missing glyphs or integrity warnings in the reviewed frames. Retained stylized low-poly world and generated illustrations; no photorealism/AAA claim. Staged endings and controlled fixtures are labelled, never represented as organic playthrough evidence.
press_scope: Selected original framebuffers may be used with accurate captions after release gate and owner acceptance; contact sheets are inspection aids only.
